parameters.functionCode: const q = $input.item.json.query || {}; const qstr = q.q || q.query || ''; const page = parseInt(q.page||1); const per = Math.min(parseInt(q.per||20),100); const offset = (page-1)*per; if(!qstr) return [{ json: [] }]; const sql = `SELECT id, title, author, substring(metadata::text, 1, 300) as snippet, (metadata->>'monetization_score')::float as monetization_score FROM works WHERE status='active' AND (title ILIKE $1 OR author ILIKE $1 OR metadata::text ILIKE $1) ORDER BY monetization_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3`; const params = [`%${qstr}%`, per, offset]; return [{ json: { query: sql, params } }];
parameters.name: Build Search SQL
